pages.title: Virtual Quark
pages.text: A quark borrowed from the vacuum, existing only on credit granted by the uncertainty principle. The more energy it has, the sooner it must be returned. It tugs constantly at the hand, trying to fall back into nothing.

$(thing)Notebook$()$(br)Virtual Pairs in the Quantum Foam dropped these when they split. Later, the Vacuum Fluctuation Harvester let me pull them from between Casimir plates and keep them cold enough to stay.

Made in $(item)Vacuum Fluctuation Harvester$().$(br2)$(thing)Mined$(): from $(item)Ephemeral Quark Ore$(), in veins through the Quantum Foam.$(br2)$(thing)Dropped by$(): Virtual Pair.$(br2)$(thing)Unlocked by$(): The Quantum Foam.$(br2)$(thing)Used in$(): Antiproton Bundle, Miniature Quasar, Path Integral, Strange & Charm Quarks, Unified Notes III, Up & Down Quarks.
